title: WorldManifest
description: Top-level world manifest — everything needed to save/load a world.

avatar_file.description: Path to an avatar definition file.

layout_file.description: Path to a separate layout file (blockout regions, spatial graph).

soundtrack.description:
The song this world performs to, with the analysis that drives
entity modulations.

AudioDef.description: Audio component attached to an entity.

radius.description: Spatial radius.  `None` = global (fills the scene), `Some(r)` = spatial.

rolloff.description: Distance rolloff model for spatial audio.

source.description: The sound source — what to play.

AudioKind.description: High-level audio category — determines mixing bus and behavior.

oneOf.description: Environmental background (wind, rain, etc.)
Sound effects (spatial, one-shot or looping).
Music track.

AudioSource.description: What sound to produce — unified taxonomy of all sound types.

oneOf.description: ABC notation music score.
External audio file reference.
Silence (placeholder / mute).

AvatarDef.description: Avatar configuration describing the user/explorer presence in a world.

height.description: Avatar eye-height above ground (used for first-person eye level).

model_entity.description:
Entity reference of the 3D model representing the avatar (3rd-person).
When `None`, the world has no visible avatar model.

movement_speed.description: Movement speed in units per second.

spawn_position.description: Where the avatar spawns in the world.

BehaviorDef.description:
Declarative behavior definition — data, not code.
Each variant fully describes a continuous animation that the tick system evaluates.

oneOf.description: Orbit around a center entity or point.

center.description: Entity to orbit around (mutually exclusive with `center_point`).

center_point.description: Fixed point to orbit around [x,y,z] (used if `center` is None).

speed.description: Orbital speed in degrees per second.

tilt.description: Orbit tilt in degrees (inclination from the axis plane).

oneOf.description: Spin (rotate) around a local axis.

speed.description: Rotation speed in degrees per second.

oneOf.description: Bob up and down (sinusoidal oscillation along an axis).

amplitude.description: Amplitude (distance from center in each direction).

oneOf.description: Continuously look at / follow another entity.
Scale pulsation (breathing effect).
Follow a path of waypoints in sequence.

mode.description: Loop mode: "loop" wraps back to start, "ping_pong" reverses.

orient_to_path.description: Smoothly interpolate rotation toward movement direction.

speed.description: Movement speed in units per second.

oneOf.description: Bouncing on a surface with gravity.

surface_y.description: Surface Y level to bounce on.

fov_degrees.description: Vertical field of view in degrees.

ComplianceMeta.description:
Regulatory and distribution compliance metadata.

Records classification signals for storefronts, regulatory frameworks,
and content-origin seals so that exported worlds carry machine-readable
provenance alongside the creative data.

eu_ai_act_risk_level.description:
EU AI Act risk-level classification.

LocalGPT Gen is a code-generation tool: the LLM produces scene definition
code (RON) that the user compiles into 3D geometry via Bevy.  Under the
EU AI Act (Regulation 2024/1689), general-purpose code-generation tools
with a human in the loop fall under the "minimal risk" tier, requiring
only transparency obligations (Art. 52) -- no conformity assessment.

generation_method.description:
How the output was produced: "code-generation" (LLM writes scene code
compiled by the engine) vs "asset-generation" (LLM directly produces
binary mesh/texture data).

generation_tool.description: Tool name and version that produced this world (e.g. "LocalGPT Gen v0.3.5").

human_modifiable.description:
Whether the output can be meaningfully edited by a human.

`true` for LocalGPT Gen because the canonical format is RON text with
parametric shapes -- users can open, read, and modify every dimension,
material, and behavior by hand.

no_gen_ai_compatible.description:
"No Gen AI" seal compatibility flag.

`true` indicates the output is human-editable source code (not opaque
binary blobs) and the creative direction is human-driven.  The scene
definition can be fully read, understood, and modified by a person,
making the output compatible with "No Gen AI" asset provenance
requirements that focus on human authorship of the final artifact.

steam_code_tool_exempt.description:
Steam "code tool" exemption flag.

`true` indicates the output is compilable/editable source code (RON scene
definitions, parametric shapes) rather than pre-made binary assets.  Under
Valve's AI content policy, tools whose output is code that the developer
compiles or modifies are treated as code tools, not AI-generated asset
generators.

CreationDef.description:
A compound creation — a named group of entities that form a logical object.

For example, a "house" creation might consist of walls, roof, door, and
chimney entities, with optional audio (fireplace) and lights (windows).

bbox_half.description: Bounding box half-extents [x, y, z] for the entire creation.

entities.description: Entity IDs that make up this creation.

semantic_category.description: Semantic category for search and classification.

CreationId.description: Unique identifier for a compound creation (group of entities).

EntityName.description: Human-readable entity name. Unique within a world but may be renamed.

EntityRef.description:
Cross-entity reference — used in behaviors, parenting, audio attachment.

LLMs produce `Name` references; these are resolved to `Id` on ingestion.
Saved worlds should only contain `Id` references.

anyOf.description: Stable reference by numeric ID (for persisted worlds).
Human-readable reference by name (for LLM tool calls).

ambient_color.description: Ambient light color, sRGB-encoded RGBA in `0..=1`.

ambient_intensity.description:
Ambient light brightness in Bevy's `GlobalAmbientLight` units
(default 80; the web viewer scales it with `AMBIENT_SCALE`).

fog_color.description:
Fog color, sRGB-encoded RGBA in `0..=1`; the background color when
unset.

LightDef.description: Light source attached to an entity.

inner_angle.description: Inner cone angle in radians (spot lights only).

intensity.description: Intensity (lumens for Point/Spot, lux for Directional).

outer_angle.description: Outer cone angle in radians (spot lights only).

range.description:
Maximum range/radius for point and spot lights (in world units).
`None` uses the engine default. Ignored for directional lights.

MaterialDef.description:
PBR material properties.  All fields mirror the Bevy `StandardMaterial`
subset that the gen tools expose.

color.description:
Base color, sRGB-encoded RGBA in `0..=1` (what Bevy's `Color::srgba`
reads; renderers convert to linear).

double_sided.description: If true, both sides of faces are rendered.

emissive.description:
Emissive color, linear RGBA (values above 1 glow). Non-zero =
self-illuminating.

unlit.description: If true, material ignores all lighting (flat shaded).

MeshAssetRef.description:
Reference to an imported mesh asset (alternative to parametric Shape).

Used for glTF/GLB imports where the geometry is too complex for
parametric shapes.

node.description: Optional node name within the asset (for multi-node glTF files).

path.description: Relative path to the asset file within the world's `assets/` directory.

ModulationDef.description: One parameter of an entity bound to a runtime signal.

range.description:
`[value at signal 0, value at signal 1]` — a multiplier for
multiplicative targets, world units for `offset_y`.

smoothing.description: Low-pass time constant in seconds (`0` = raw signal).

target.description: Which parameter of the entity is driven.

ModulationTarget.description: The entity parameter a modulation drives.

oneOf.description: Multiplies the material's emissive color.
Multiplies the entity's scale uniformly.
Multiplies the light's intensity.
Multiplies the material's alpha.
Adds an offset (world units) to the entity's Y position.
Camera at avatar eye level; avatar model not visible.
Camera orbits behind/above the avatar; avatar model visible.

Rolloff.description: Distance rolloff model for spatial audio.

SemanticCategory.description: Semantic category for a creation (aids LLM reasoning and search).

Shape.description: A parametric primitive shape with inline dimensions.

oneOf.description:
The soundtrack's loudness envelope
([`SoundtrackDef::energy`](crate::SoundtrackDef::energy)).

`1` on each beat, decaying linearly to `0` at the next
([`SoundtrackDef::beat_at`](crate::SoundtrackDef::beat_at)).

Low band level. Live audio when playing; else the `bass` stem, else
`energy`.

High band level. Live audio when playing; else the `other` stem, else
`energy`.

A separated stem's envelope; falls back to `energy` when the
soundtrack carries no stems.
A free-running sine, `0..=1`, at `frequency` Hz. Needs no soundtrack.
A fixed value — for authoring and previews.

SoundtrackDef.description: The soundtrack and the analysis it was performed from.

beat_offset.description: Time of the first beat in seconds.

bpm.description: Beats per minute; `0` means no reliable beat grid.

energy.description: Loudness envelope, one value per second, normalized to `0..=1`.

license.description:
License of the audio (an SPDX id such as `CC0-1.0`, or free text).
Set it whenever `path` is.

path.description:
Audio file relative to the world's `assets/` directory. `None`: no
audio ships with the world; the curves below still drive modulations.

sections.description:
Section boundaries as fractions of `duration` in `0..=1`, ascending,
starting with `0`.

stems.description: Per-stem envelopes aligned to `energy`, when the track was separated.

TourDef.description: A guided tour — a named, ordered sequence of waypoints through the world.

autostart.description: If true, this tour starts automatically when the world is loaded.

loop_tour.description: If true, the tour loops back to the first waypoint after the last.

pov.description: Optional PoV override for this tour (falls back to avatar default).

TourMode.description: How the camera/avatar moves between tour waypoints.

oneOf.description: Ground-level movement respecting gravity / terrain.
Free-flying camera interpolation.
Instant teleport between waypoints (cut, no interpolation).

TourWaypoint.description: A single stop along a guided tour.

description.description: Narrative text shown to the user at this stop.

look_at.description: Where the camera looks at this stop.

pause_duration.description: How long to pause at this waypoint (seconds) before moving on.

position.description: Camera / avatar position at this stop.

WaveformType.description: Waveform type for custom audio synthesis.

WorldEntity.description:
A single entity in the world.  Component slots are all optional —
any combination is valid (e.g., a glowing orb has shape + light + audio).

behaviors.description: Behaviors stack — multiple can be active simultaneously.

creation_id.description: If this entity belongs to a compound creation.

light.description: Light source — can coexist with shape (e.g., glowing orb).

mesh_asset.description: Reference to an imported mesh asset (alternative to Shape).

modulations.description:
Signal-driven modulations (soundtrack energy, beat, oscillators)
stacked on top of the authored values.

shape.description: Parametric shape — never loses dimension info.

bevy_version.description: Bevy engine version targeted by this world's generated code.

compliance.description: Compliance metadata for distribution and regulatory classification.

name.description: World name (used as skill name / directory name).

prompt.description: Original prompt used to generate this world.

tags.description: Free-form style tags for gallery filtering.

time_of_day.description: Time of day (0.0-24.0, for lighting presets).

variation_group.description: If part of a variation experiment, the group ID.

WorldTransform.description: Transform in world space (or parent-relative if parented).

rotation_degrees.description: Euler rotation in degrees [pitch, yaw, roll].
